stem.text: Which of the following images shows critical view of safety?

feedback.text: The answer is incorrect because, although the cystic duct and cystic artery are shown as separate and high, the required object "dissected" is missing from the image. This means the critical view of safety is not fully achieved.
The answer is correct as the image shows the critical view of safety with the cystic duct and cystic artery clearly separated and the gallbladder dissected, fulfilling all required elements.
